criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Inquiries related to opening, closing, or managing bank accounts.

categories.name: Card Issues
categories.definition: Questions or problems regarding physical or virtual cards, including activation, replacement, and usage.

categories.name: Transaction Disputes
categories.definition: Concerns about unauthorized transactions, duplicate charges, or transaction errors.

categories.name: Funds Transfer
categories.definition: Inquiries about transferring money between accounts or to other individuals.

categories.name: Top-Up Issues
categories.definition: Problems or questions related to adding funds to an account or card.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Questions regarding fees associated with transactions, account maintenance, or services.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Inquiries about the process and requirements for verifying identity.

categories.name: Security Concerns
categories.definition: Reports of lost or stolen cards, unauthorized access, or suspicious activity.

categories.name: Technical Issues
categories.definition: Problems related to the banking app or website functionality.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Questions about currency conversion rates, fees, and processes.

categories.name: PIN Management
categories.definition: Inquiries about setting, changing, or recovering PINs for accounts or cards.

categories.name: Refund Requests
categories.definition: Requests for refunds on transactions or inquiries about the refund process.

categories.name: ATM Issues
categories.definition: Problems encountered while using ATMs, including cash withdrawals and card retrieval.

categories.name: Account Security
categories.definition: Concerns about account security measures and how to enhance them.

categories.name: Customer Feedback
categories.definition: Comments or complaints regarding customer service or banking experience.
